issues.reason: "Sailsworn is a Council member" is a copular clause with an individual subject, which Categorical statements routes to a Member atom, and the part-whole precedent keeps the head noun's own kind atom beside the link ("the car engine" → (Member sk_engine_1 engine) (PartOf sk_engine_1 sk_car_1)), so the clause's own predication is left unrecorded.

defect_summary: Compliant form adds the categorical atom (Member sailsworn member) beside the existing (PartOf sailsworn sk_council_1) and (Member sk_council_1 council).
notes: The PartOf encoding of "Council member" is itself licensed — PartOf's second job is membership in a group, and the possessor/whole + part reading blocks fusion — as is treating "Council" as a capitalized common-noun label with a witness and no Name atom.
